shared_elements: standing human figure in low relief
figure holding an object in the hand
carved relief on a stone slab surface
justification: Both depict standing human figures in relief wearing headgear and holding objects, but that is a near-universal convention; A shows a single frontal, densely ornamented figure whose body is engulfed in dense glyph-like and mask motifs filling every space, while B shows a repeated procession of plain profile figures each carrying a bowl or vessel with generous blank ground. The proportions, the profile-versus-frontal orientation, the serial repetition versus single dominating figure, and the presence of script-like ornament in A make the depicted schemes fundamentally unrelated.
